releases.notes:
Port of SOL: Valheim to Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge.

## Install

Drop `sol_valheim-1.2.0.jar` into your NeoForge 1.21.1 server/client `mods/` folder. Requires:
- NeoForge 21.1.95+
- Architectury API
- Cloth Config

## Changes vs upstream 1.1.1

- Targets Minecraft 1.21.1 (was 1.20.1)
- Switched Forge → NeoForge; Fabric loader still supported in source
- Migrated to 1.21.1 component-based food API, new SynchedEntityData builder, new AttributeModifier `ResourceLocation` id, `Holder<MobEffect>` references, etc.
- NeoForge `EntityDataSerializer` registered via `NeoForgeRegistries.ENTITY_DATA_SERIALIZERS` (vanilla registry is locked for mods on NeoForge)
- Eating-path mixins (`ItemMixin`, `PlayerEntityMixin`, `CakeBlockMixin`) bumped to priority 1500 to override conflicting mod mixins
- Food slot time display: shows `Xh` for 1–9 hours and `9+` beyond, so 3-digit minute values no longer overflow the slot
